text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I team up with Mejiro Ryan, an Umamusume dedicated to strength training, and we decide to take on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan envies Mejiro McQueen, the most talented racer in the Mejiro family, and desires nothing more than to beat her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that goal in mind, we commence our journey together.
